Exploit Confusion

You see the enemy stagger under a companion’s blow and dart in before they can gather themselves.

Rules

Action: Reaction · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: A visible enemy within 3 squares, after another creature applies temporary Dazed, Blinded or Frightened to it.

Move up to 2 squares toward that enemy without provoking. If you finish adjacent, make one free Basic Melee attack using Brawn; on Strong you may also move 1 square without provoking afterward. You need a melee weapon and must be able to attack. If the triggering condition came from a free attack, it cannot trigger this card’s free attack. No further free attacks arise from your attack.

Duration: Immediate approach, attack and possible exit.

Equipment / acquisition: Requires a melee weapon for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Class Shadow; minimum level 7

Type: Signature

Tags: Skill / Attack / Movement

Limits: Repeatable; normal action economy applies.

ID: signature-shadow-exploit-confusion
